description_en: Configures the driver for an edge instance
description_zh: 调用该接口配置边缘实例驱动
kebab_example: aliyun iot set-edge-instance-driver-configs --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-id 021d154d2a2f4dd7a489773d9e040000 --configs Format=JSON Content=test_:123 Key=key1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetEdgeInstanceDriverConfigs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the driver. On the Driver Management page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

fields.help_en:

The configuration content text. For the format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120906.html.
The Object Storage Service (OSS) address where the configuration file is stored

配置内容，可以选择传入：

fields.help_en: The format of the configuration file. Valid values: KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file)
fields.help_zh: 配置文件格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The key of the configuration. This parameter is used to distinguish configurations when multiple configurations exist
fields.help_zh: 配置的关键字。在有多个配置的情况下，用于区分配置
